title: Bar Juice 5000 Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Juice 5000 Cherry Ice Nic Salt delivers a punchy fruit-and-ice combo that’s packed with flavour. The rich, sweet taste of ripe Cherries comes through first, followed by a bracing burst of Ice that cools the finish without masking the fruit. It’s a clean, striking profile that fans of icy vapes and classic Cherry notes will appreciate. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid produces discreet vapour with full flavour clarity, making it a great choice for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits, vape pens, or classic e-cigarettes. The nicotine salt base absorbs quickly for rapid relief from cravings, and offers a tactile yet comfortable throat hit that suits everyday vaping. Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts are crafted to emulate the UK’s favourite disposable flavours while reducing waste—giving you the same satisfaction in a more sustainable format. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths.
